Republican Task Force Issue: 5/12/2026
Trump Meets Xi in Beijing

President Trump traveled to Beijing for [his first state visit](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLHO4yAQhJ_G7rBgMZCG4hp3ufZKawPrZC-ALUzi3NufnEf4q9FopNF88-c6X5ETl_tvzORrW-a4xrnVV95axTelva3hwQUj5TXUGSRYIY1QMJc0qz76GCKq0JNXzl0suIuD_uFvqBdrtIXFjQYtWT0a7TRGLUcJyvTszyppFIBWzsjhpiIoa8g4dArVpRslJqptqLS9bokDlob7c1lroCGsuU_-0dq2d_pXB1MH03Ecw7J-Ch37mXcwJX6TOH0H0xdJfFHEh8VfLhuXu8hE7dRWMZJomJ67aMgHFsEVi8j4Tyjoq4_bwSnxbl03yntGTt8R7QefvT38DwAA___fhXzt) to China in his second term, opening two days of talks with President Xi Jinping on trade, Taiwan, and the Iran conflict. No breakthroughs are expected--the goal is to stabilize a relationship battered by months of tariff tensions. Joining Trump's delegation are [Elon Musk, Tim Cook](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGOpDAQRL_GZCC7wZgJHFxCNpdeiHrsBlpnbGQ8MPv3qxntF2xYpVKp6v27T3fkwHH5ixvZXObJJz-V_Nz2kvGkcJTkVo7oaUsuTyChr6WuFUwxTKry1juPylVklTFDD2YwUK12GLqbdL73UquOpMdZt107D9h5dzPmUbF9V0mtAFpltGweyoPqNWmDRqEaRCcxUC5Npv35COwwFjz-zyk7alzaqmDXUvZDtH8EjALG67qaC4-V41JSpBduHCm_owLGPQV2XwLGQm6NKaTlLTrdt6Y3P3ZNL3LPwicd9edz_eFQv7g--eAiYKyy9fvFIfDRG9HJZUMOnzXlF_BOC98BAAD__9jUgCg), BlackRock's Larry Fink, and over a dozen other top executives. The most contentious agenda item is Beijing's ongoing material and economic support for Iran and Russia. U.S. officials say [China has been backing Tehran](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LvOozAUBOCngc4IH4INhYtt6P5tt0QHX-AoviDbhDz-KnmEvx5pNN_8-1l_kDzF_S8Gq3J1q0lmrfkKZ834sr7UpA-KaGxIOq_Qg2D9yDis0a-8Ncpog1y3VnEpJwFyktAeataDExzhIXvh5nnmwslp2ty4DWCMHVpSn6p-5AADl2PfbdwAF6MdJUqOfGoePXqba5fteW2eNMaK5elS1rbTKbReHbWepRn-NLA0sNz33bn0jvYun7yB5UyeKunSwPIVMZ2iyylW9iZ20H6wUvFpCytXCFRZetnMvlq2oX5S3BlljCxfpRC2WZnzJu-pCNk8-j0g-e-S-ovjXgr-BwAA__-EkYCM) throughout the conflict, and Trump plans to press Xi directly on cutting it off. ★★★
Makary out at FDA

FDA Commissioner Marty Makary [resigned Tuesday](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDHO4yAUhE-DOyzAAbwFxTbusu2W1jPv4aDFYAGJc_xVcoS_nZFm9H1_7-sdYop5_wMHudrDigXXXp_H2Su8KLVe_CNmQDqKr6sSynChuVRrTqsc0KFHkH4gJ62djbKzVcPD4QbeaprCDDeUOMspmBAkGTGRNv7XEN1nSmip1CStFuMmUUmjSVuwEuTMbgIS1T5WOp9bih5yh_YvlOpp9OUYknv0fjY2_WZqYWq5rmsM5Z3pap-eqeUsKfboG1PLl6jxgMC30hqv1OKeY9454BEz73A2nundOfj-iRMBUh2qw_OKKcVmLLuJ_YCYvu_9B7JeTv0PAAD__yiWfH0), ending a turbulent year-long tenure marked by clashes over abortion pill enforcement, vaping approvals, and pharmaceutical industry tension. The White House confirmed Makary's exit hours before President Trump departed for Beijing, with Kyle Diamantas, the FDA's human foods deputy commissioner and [architect of](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLtugzAUQL_GbCD7gjEdPHTxlq4d0Y0fwYofyNyE5u-r9BO6Hx0dne_LesGYYrl9Yfa6UVhddSu1R96p4dOng6rdYkHnc7VtBQ5zz2UvYC1pFZ3TzjoUtvNaKLXMoBYF3aYDyI-rdeOkLCxcyYCjk0EJqyYe5By6qN8qLgXAKJTkw1U4ELP0UqESKBY2cUy-0dD8_rimaLEQHvdQm_WDrblLeiPaDzZ-MjAMzHmew4nHFsuNavE_mGPx7Y0yMHtN0b4YmM1jos1i8wzMJOdJzgsDk7HRq894x_bq64N6pD44ZGC6pt1-xpTiMSs28VvGmP4C6B-_nhp-AwAA__8hSXqo) the 2025 Dietary Guidelines, stepping in as acting chief. Health Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr. reportedly pushed for the resignation amid mounting MAHA coalition frustration. Conservative critics blamed Makary for slow-walking the mifepristone safety review and resisting [flavored vape approvals](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckL2SgyAURp8GOxy4ipiCYhu7bLulc4VrZMKPgyRu3n4neYTtv_nmnPNzna_og0-3b4xkSl1nl91cyyPuteCTwlGz3XxCRzHbMoOAgQvFJcwpzLJxxlmH0jZkpNbjAHrU0GzGXWBZRGcvA4Ad-0UJ0feAPa5isQPZxpv3lVASoJNaiXaRDuSgSGnUEuXIeoGBSm0L7Y8leIup4nFfc7HU2hybYLZa94N1XwwmBtN5nu2Jx-bTreZEvxh9ovKeMpjyzskdDKZeDZ0aNYPpI8lXX4hHLPXFI96xvPjqkOOSH5VXH4nB1BTj9tOH4I9Bs17cIvrwQaj_KPY08BcAAP__FcF7lg). Sen. Bill Cassidy and pro-life groups had publicly called for his ouster. ★★★
Mayor Charged As China agent

Federal prosecutors Monday charged former Arcadia, California, Mayor Eileen Wang as an [illegal foreign agent](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckD3O5CAQRE9jZ1jQ_sEJwSbOvk03tNpN40GDwQI83rn9auYIG5ZKKtV7f37WH_TBx_03HmxydatNdq35Os6a8cWh1EQPH9HykSivIGESchQK1hhW1VpjyaKilo3Sep5AzxrahwGHTm40DQpoGPtNbdTLSWmcZulGtq03nyk5KoBe6VF2m7KgppFHjVqhmptBYuBcu8zntQVPGCuWp0uZuKN0tME8aj1L0_9qYGlgue-7c-lv5Lt8-gaWqzSwEAbvUo4exYHvlAUSXYWtKEyZa3iLO-Wnj7v4copyZkb7yWdOJ-4YLYrknCcWjm1ps7Hn7UPwZdLNIPcDffgeqv_h72XgXwAAAP__WTyDZw) of China, and she resigned and agreed to plead guilty to a felony carrying up to 10 years in prison. Wang admitted operating a website called U.S. News Center that pushed [pro-PRC propaganda](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGOszAQhJ_GdI7sJcakcPE3dPnbK9FiL-A7Y6PFSZS3P5FHuHpGM5--r_t4x5hiXv7jRo7rPIYSxsqPba-MT0pHLX6NGQNtxfMICjqpjNQw5jTqJrjgA2rfkNPW9h3Y3kKzOsBbmFpL1vR4tXC7zbY30HeqpdDi1DXRnVPKaIBWW6Mukw6gO0PGotWoe3FVmIjrhWl_TCl6zBWPn7mwp4svW5PcWut-iPafgEHAEDCmt8eUiM9cwHA-CBiUETBoOCvlW_oVeaFDUkxEWb4wL3LDd2GJ7DFElB5TnAvniHIuTHHJEhfKVX5ECBgadmF_xZTi0VlxVcuGMX2Y6h8UPh38BgAA__81qIA3) at the direction of Chinese officials from 2020 to 2022. Court documents show Wang coordinated with a high-level Chinese intelligence operative who met personally with Xi Jinping. The FBI's Roman Rozhavsky said Wang [served Chinese interests](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLGO8yAQhJ8Gd1jeTQCnoPgbuvztldYacIIOGws2sfL2J98jXDsazXz6vu7TnVJO2-M_rdFWXqZQwsT1te5c6R1z4-KfaaMQ1-LrhANqOSgJOG15gi7Y4AOB76IFY0aNZjTYPa0abzAu2oBX2tz0crtEMGYh78HQPOou2XNqUIB4AaOGfoaAoFVUhgwQjOI6UI6V-xr315yTp42pfS-l-tj7snbZPpn3Ji7_BDqB7jiOfq4x8UyVz4ZAt5ecOPkm0J13At2gBDoAgW6lT6myLJKqp5BIxpRj3ORB20NSWBM3yUWS53QGTZ4eYouy7R-Brqs27EfKOTVtxHV4rJTyLxj_wePb4k8AAAD__88agdA) secretly. The Democrat had become the first Chinese-American woman elected to the Arcadia council.
Pratt Slams Democrats Over Anti-Semitism

Leaked messages show [Los Angeles Mayoral hopeful Spencer Pratt](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckDuO4zAQBU8jZRTI1odywGATZd50Q6FFtmTC_Ahk29q5_cBzhIkfXqFQ_-7rHX3w6fiLkUzhfXXZrVxe8eSCbwqVs334hI5itmUFCZOQo1CwprCq1hlnHSrbklFazxPoWUP7MIo218Nt6KcecR8UDPttxtssNyCJ0rbefFByVAC90qPsNuVATSONGrVCNTeDxECFu0LnawveYmKszz0XS53NsQ3mwXzWpv_TwNLAcl1Xt-f_ia762RtYKDEVRp8iJW5gqSclS0WcBZnFFrByFQFFIHRUqjgDfvl0iB2L4JyFfTEJTOwrRc--RoEh0EHu83iSE5FqxYNqW4w7Lx-Cr5NuBnlE9OFHkn_R9G3gOwAA__8LsYsQ) blasting Democrat leaders for tolerating anti-Semitism in their ranks.

★★★
Democrats Meltdown Over Virginia Ruling

Republicans blasted Democrats for scheming to unravel checks and balances by [floating a plot](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLuunTAQRb8GOiPbPHxu4SIN3U2bEg32AJP4gcYGkr-PTpQvuPXWXlpaPz6XT6BAaf8OES3XbfHZL5WveFaGG0Op2R2UwGPMjhct9STkKJReUlhU6613HpRr0SpjXpM2L6Pbw364fuv7AXBUk5bbYD5Wt-IwOdByAt-3ZN8oOSqte2VG2a3KazWNOBowCtSrGSQE5NoxntcayEGqUH5tmR12Lsc22KPWszT9t0bPjZ6f5-m2_DvhU957o-czB6rkSqPnm3inRCD2fIqA4JHFGqDUIs78IIvjSjv_ET9x25iwCI-xiJivVAWlAgnFDnGlKvKN_P9C-yFcvri2bP35UAhUJtMMco9A4Z9k_ULT2-q_AQAA__9LS4tn) to replace the entire Virginia Supreme Court with liberal justices after the court threw out a Democrat gerrymander that redrew the commonwealth's Congressional map to favor Democrats 10-1.

★★★
Poll: Voters Blame Trump Policies

A [CNN/SSRS poll](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0D1u6zAQBODTUJ0Ecm1p7YLFa9T5tSmF1ZK0F-GPQNEWcvvAAXKB1DP4MJiP23IjiZLv_yl5W1tYXHFLq8-0tUovH_dW-CGZnE-F6wIapl6PvYElx8V0zjp2ZLjz1iBeJsALQvewLoSVceIQVrrq6xkcMuI6XR0joJ46sW9KjwbgZHDUw2ocmGn0IxIaMhd11hR9bUP123ONwpQb7Z-hVPYDl9RF-2ht29Xpn4JZwXwcx8A5vzMF81tXMOtRwWxAwbyVKE14VzBzzv1WYuyTuOZr2nsKoVRHq0RpX_1vtZe0EbeuWrcdEqPsE6qzvieS-DOh_eGxl4XvAAAA___vHnuL) finds 77% of Americans--including most Republicans--say Trump's policies raised the cost of living. Democrats are expanding their generic ballot lead, grim data for a party trying to hold its House majority.

* * *
Warsh Confirmed as Fed Governor

The Senate voted 51-45 to [confirm Kevin Warsh](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0LHO4yAQBOCnwR2W2QTjFBTXuMu1V1obWGIUDNZCbN3bn3yP8JejkT6N5s9zeWJMMb9_40aWW1h88Uvj77Y3xoNSbcWtMaOnrTheYIBRDloqWHJaVOetdx6V68gqY6YRzGSgWy2ODwqjocdtMi7o4HHUwU_OkPd3gtBFe1GDVgA3ZfTQv5QHNWrSBo1CNYn7gIm49Uz795Wiw9ywfkJhR70rW5fs2tpexe2XgFnAfJ5n7_LLXaWA-eIFzIMWMCsQMFfK2Ei6kkPkrcoPHTHLE7muEqsM5OW7HMS5sHSJkKs88a8MV1wxsjxKo35tW-rY-v2MKcU6GnEf3hvG9H9T-8GFh4V_AQAA___O8oIO) as a Fed Board Governor, clearing the path for a separate Chair vote expected Wednesday. Democrats warned that Warsh would cut rates under presidential pressure. Powell's term expires Friday.

★★★
Trump's Beef Orders Stall

The White House delayed signing executive orders to slash beef import tariffs and rebuild the U.S. cattle herd, saying it is "fine-tuning" the actions. [Beef prices](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyckLEO2yAURb8Gb1jwEgwZGLp4S9eOFobnGBUb6_Ecq39fJUM_oOu90tU959dzeoZc8v76GTb0xMuUapqYzu1gCm8sjWtc8x4SbjXSBAoGqYzUMO1l0l3yKaagY4deW-sGsM5Ct_q7U85ZuCmMxibljDM6DoNZ4mDjwz267D9TymiAm7ZG9bNOoAeDxgarg3birkJB4p7wOOeSY9g5tN9LpYh9rFtX_Mp8NHH7IWAUMF7X1ROejNQ-_SepVJKA8WwCxi-TbPm1y0oJqcm51sZyRlxk3o5K3CThfOaSZAzMBeWKlOS1Zka51rOhbOFPk_8caAFjRz4dVy4lt8GKu3ptIZfvP_4PnW8PfwMAAP__GZyFLQ) are up 16% over the past year.

Senate Eyes Shutdown Leverage

Senate Democrats are weighing procedural moves to gain leverage in government funding talks as [shutdown fears grow](https://email.alert.republicantaskforce.com/c/eJyc0D2OwyAQxfHTQEfEjD-wC4pt3GXbLa0xjGO0GFtAkuuv4iNs_aS_9Hs_9_lOIYb0-Kadba7r7A8_1_zcz5rpxbHUw20hkef9cHlGjb3SnQKcU5xBeuudJ3CSLRgz9GgGg3KzzQArGD8uYwOwrGPrWzLjSLh60Ky1DPaT0h0gNmA6fVvAI_Qdd4YMEAyi1RQ511vm87nE4ChVKr_rkR3f3LHLaLdazyKaL4GTwKluvIUYP5vAaTt2TvwuAqfCiSoLnLrBYK9BxfBi9Tw9VS7qsqqQKakLKnCS2frzHWIMpTei1Y-dwtWV9R8XvSz-BQAA__9eBXV2). Congress returned from recess facing overlapping deadlines on Department of Homeland Security (DHS) funding, the farm bill, and a national security authorization.

Folks, if you could spare just one minute, please hear me out.
I'll be honest: I'm about to ask you to [donate to help us reach our $50,000 goal before tomorrow's public filing deadline](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/131281629/620557302/-1487442751?amounts=5,25,50,100,250&refcode=jtk1273-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjgvMS83NDc5MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4NDUwYTUzMS01YjRlLWYxMTEtOGVmMi0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=VOwKu6fnGbyc8pwAJ7VW2Gj007zc60VB7YXmU3obDPU=)**. But before I do that, I need to explain why this is the _most_ _important_ fundraising deadline of our campaign so far.**
See, until the primary on June 30, state campaigns in Colorado are required by law**** to publicly report how much they've raised every two weeks.
And as the front-runner in the governor's race, I'm every other candidate's top target to defeat. That means our fundraising numbers will face the highest level of scrutiny.
We already came up short of our goal last time around, so we simply cannot afford to come up short again now. Especially not when Phil Weiser is outspending us by millions of dollars to drown out our message on TV and flood the web with dishonest attacks against me.

clean_body: I've enclosed our latest campaign update on the status of this critical runoff election. Please Read: | MESSAGE FROM CHIP ROY Let me be direct. Nearly two million Texans turned out in the Republican Primary for Attorney General—and despite being massively outspent and targeted by the political establishment and their wealthy backers, we forced this race into a runoff. That didn't happen by accident. It happened because the people of Texas still value truth over spin—and results over a bankroll. My opponent poured more than $16 million of his own money into this race, only to finish at 39%. Meanwhile, we were hit by a California-based, left-wing PAC angry that I stood with Donald Trump to strip out hundreds of billions in Green New Deal-style subsidies from the so-called "Big Beautiful Bill." They thought they could buy Texas.They were wrong. The runoff election is May 26 - less than three weeks away - and with your help, we're going to finish what we started and prove, once again, that Texas isn't for sale. But let's be honest about what's at stake. This is no time to hand the Attorney General's office to someone who's never set foot in a courtroom. Texas is facing serious challenges: a wide-open border, foreign adversaries buying up our land, and a radical agenda determined to reshape our state and our country. We need a proven conservative who knows how to fight - and win. The Attorney General isn't a ceremonial role. It's the chief legal officer of the largest conservative state in America. It requires leadership from day one—building a strong legal team, enforcing the law without hesitation, and taking the fight wherever it's needed to defend Texas. I'm ready to do that. But I need to know if conservatives like you are in this fight with me. Between now and May 26th, I'll be working around the clock to make sure Texans understand exactly what's on the line in this runoff. Let's finish this. Peter,
Back in January, I stood with Colorado Workers United and union members at the Capitol for the re-launch of the Worker Protection Act. This bill would strengthen the right of unions to organize.
secure.actblue.com/donate/2605-q2-jg? [secure.actblue.com/donate/2605-q2-jg?]
Here in Colorado, there are still real barriers that prevent hardworking people from freely and fairly exercising their right to collectively bargain for better pay and safer workplaces.
That’s why it’s so important that this bill passed the legislature again and why it matters that it’s now back on the Governor’s desk after last year’s veto. This bill is a critical first step in strengthening protections for workers. And as your Attorney General, I’ll keep building on that progress.
Colorado’s workers built this state — and they deserve an Attorney General who always has their back. If you’re with me, chip in today to help us keep up the fight for working families. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/2605-q2-jg?]
DONATE [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2605-q2-jg?]As your AG, I’ll staff up an office of workers rights to combat wage theft, illegal union busting, and other illegal practices that make life harder for workers. I’ll defend the right to organize and collective bargaining. I’ll hold corporations accountable when they break the law or put workers at risk. And I’ll fight for laws that guarantee fair pay, safe workplaces, and equal opportunity for everyone.
In solidarity,
Jena

| | Peter,
---
If you ever doubted we could win America's youth back from the Left...

If you ever wondered whether we'd lost the next generation for good...

If you ever sat up at night -- watching the news, seeing what's happening in our schools, our culture, our country -- and thought, _" Is it already too late?" _

You're not alone.

A lot of good people have been asking the same question.

**But I want to tell you something that might just change how you feel about the future of this country... **

Just one year ago, Turning Point USA's high school program -- which is now called "Club America" -- was in about 1,200 schools.

That was no small feat.

Starting a single chapter today takes serious courage. Students get mocked. Threatened. Investigated. Sometimes even physically attacked.

So reaching 1,200 chapters already felt like a miracle.

_Then Charlie called me... _

He said: "Andrew, I love what we're doing with our high school program -- but we've got to move faster."

I told him, "We are."

Charlie replied, "No you're not thinking what I'm thinking... I want to be in 35,000 high schools."

I laughed. I told him, "Charlie, there aren't even 35,000 high schools in America."

"Okay," he said, "How many are there?"

"About 27,000."

Without skipping a beat, Charlie said, "Okay, great. Let's do 27,000!"
I'll be honest -- I froze.

We didn't have the numbers. We didn't have the staff. We didn't have the roadmap yet.

But he wasn't fazed.

He said, "Don't worry. We'll figure it out. We'll do it together."

That was Charlie.

He didn't think small. He didn't move slow. He didn't settle for "maybe someday."

He believed in going now.

And he believed that if the mission was right, the path would reveal itself.

He chased what others only dreamed about... and turned what others thought impossible into reality.

That's why he built Turning Point USA in the first place.

That's why tens of thousands of students were inspired by Charlie to start chapters of their own -- _many in schools where they were explicitly told not to. _

**And that 's why today -- less than a year later -- we're not in 1,200 schools anymore: **

We're in 3,300.

That's roughly 13% of all high schools in America.

Eight states have officially partnered with Club America to bring our chapters into every school statewide.

✅ Florida
✅ Texas
✅ Tennessee

✅ Montana
✅ Nebraska

And we're just getting started.

Think about that: 13% of America's youth now have a place at school where they can say it's okay to love this country...

That it's okay to be bold. That it's okay to believe in God, in family, and in freedom.

_That 's what Club America is about... _

**Giving the next generation a place where they can find their courage, develop grit, and learn how to lead the fight for their country. **

**What will it take to bring Club America to the next 3,300 schools? What will it take to bring it to all 27,000? **

Because here's the truth:

These students aren't just signing up. _They 're stepping up. _

They're leading chapters in schools where America is attacked... where they're often targeted for daring to say what they believe... and where speaking the truth is dangerous.

But that isn't stopping them.

They're still showing up. They're speaking out. And they're growing stronger than ever.

They're becoming exactly the kind of young patriots Charlie believed in -- not just bold, _but brave_. Not just loud, but _principled_.
